FEATURED TRAILERS
London - Fulham Broadway
Located inside the Fulham Broadway Retail Centre, Vue Fulham Broadway has 9 screens with over 2,250 seats.
Watch the newest releases at the town’s state-of-the-art cinema, and enjoy 2D and 3D films in 4K picture quality and premium Dolby Surround Sound. Catch the newest blockbuster movies and kids’ films , or watch the best concerts, sport, dance, opera, and theatre performances with our Big Screen Events . Check out the latest trailers , browse cinema listings and times, and book tickets online for Vue Fulham Broadway. Take advantage of special screenings and offers at Vue Fulham Broadway, including Mighty Mornings or Big Shorts for kids and 2-for-1 tickets with Meerkat Movies.

Accessibility
Vue is dedicated to giving each and every one of our guests an exceptional big screen experience.
Below, you'll find accessibility information for Vue London - Fulham Broadway, including details on accessible and autism-friendly screenings. We welcome assistance dogs into all our venues.
If you'd like any more information, give our customer services team a call on 0345 308 4620 *. You can also ask a member of our staff during your visit.
